_: What to ASK the generator for. `sandbox.json` beside this holds the ids that came BACK and is what ships; this holds the words, so a body can be re-asked, re-rolled or asked for again on a fresh account without anybody reconstructing what was said. `tools/art/body.mts` reads it.
_say: A state's `say` is `action_description` and the tool warns off environment: movement and pose only, and no room, no floor, no light. Two things are learned and both are in here — naming a weapon the rotation does not hold invents a DIFFERENT one per frame, and an animation drifts off model across its run, so short is safer and 'side profile' is worth saying out loud.

bodies.name: Delver
bodies.look: a traveller who has been underground far too long: hooded and hunched, a heavy cloak gone to rags at the hem, a bedroll still strapped across the back, boots and wraps caked in rock dust. Grimy off-white and dull grey-brown cloth, nothing bright on him but one pale eye under the hood. No armour plate, no weapon drawn, no glow.

idle.say: standing still, weight settling from one foot to the other, shoulders rising and falling, cloak hanging

walk.say: walking forward at a tired trudge, head down, cloak swaying behind the legs

attack.say: staying in strict side profile, stepping onto the front foot and swinging one arm down and across in front of the body, then drawing it back

cast.say: strict side profile, feet planted apart, one open hand driven forward from the chest and held out, the other fist pulled back to the hip

bodies.name: Fissure Skeleton
bodies.look: a mine skeleton: dry grey-white bone gone the colour of the rock it was buried in, a cracked skull with two dim points of light in the eye sockets, ribs showing through the rotted remains of a canvas miner coat, one hand bare bone and the other still gripping a rusted iron pick. Cool bone white and desaturated grey-brown, dull rust on the iron. No blood, no gore, no red, no glow and no magic aura of any kind — one flat dead body.

idle.say: standing still on guard, breathing slowly, ribcage and shoulders rising and settling, head barely moving

walk.say: walking forward with a stiff shambling gait, legs swinging from the hip, arms hanging and swaying

attack.say: staying in strict side profile, lunging forward onto the front foot and driving one clawed hand straight ahead at chest height, then pulling it back

bolt.say: planting the back foot, drawing one open palm back beside the skull and thrusting it forward, hurling something away from the hand

frost_bolt.say: side profile, weight dropping onto a wide stance while both arms punch straight out from the ribs with the hands open, then fold back to the chest

arc.say: lifting one arm high with the fingers splayed wide, arching the spine back, then whipping the arm down and forward

bodies.name: Fissure Revenant
bodies.look: an evil skeletal sorcerer: a tall gaunt skeleton in a long ragged black hooded cape that hangs to the ankles and is torn to strips at the hem, the hood pulled up and thrown back off a cracked elongated skull, two hot points of pale light burning deep in the eye sockets, a heavy black iron collar and chain-scraps at the shoulders, bare finger bones. Bone the colour of old rock, cape near-black charcoal with a cold grey edge where the light catches it. Menacing and predatory. No blood, no gore, no red, no fire and no magic aura around the body.

idle.say: standing still and hunched forward, breathing, the long cape hanging and stirring at the hem, head barely moving

walk.say: stalking forward with long slow strides, shoulders hunched, the long cape trailing and swaying behind the legs

attack.say: staying in strict side profile, lunging forward onto the front foot and raking one clawed hand across at chest height, then pulling it back

bolt.say: planting the back foot, drawing one open palm back beside the skull and thrusting it forward, hurling something away from the hand

frost_bolt.say: side profile, weight dropping onto a wide stance while both arms punch straight out from the ribs with the hands open, then fold back to the chest

arc.say: lifting one arm high with the fingers splayed wide, arching the spine back, then whipping the arm down and forward

_props: What a prop must SAY. `view` already defaults to high top-down and does not carry the framing on its own — the description has to, in capitals, or an object comes back 3/4-projected and reads as furniture from a different game. Naming a thing gets you ONE of it, so a scatter says 'spread apart with gaps'. And the palette words are the zone's own, by exclusion as well as by number, or a prop lands warmer and more cheerful than the stone around it.
